instruction: click.Argument.get_help_record(ctx) returns None when the argument has no help text, so callers must special-case it. It should always return a (metavar, help) tuple, with an empty string when help is None or empty: for click.Argument(['src']) it returns ('SRC', ''), and with help='Source path' it returns ('SRC', 'Source path'). Update the help output code that relied on None, document the change, and add tests.
instruction_source: written from the fix commit message, linked issue and hidden tests; describes behavior, not the change
